help_lines: -C,    --cpu-mask M                     CPU affinity mask: arbitrarily long hex. Complements cpu-range
-c,    --ctx-size N                     size of the prompt context (default: 0, 0 = loaded from model)
-n,    --predict, --n-predict N         number of tokens to predict (default: -1, -1 = infinity)
-p,    --prompt PROMPT                  prompt to start generation with; for system message, use -sys
-ngl,  --gpu-layers, --n-gpu-layers N   max. number of layers to store in VRAM, either an exact number,
-mm,   --mmproj FILE                    path to a multimodal projector file. see tools/mtmd/README.md
--image, --audio, --video FILE          path to an image, audio, or video file. use with multimodal models,
--jinja, --no-jinja                     whether to use jinja template engine for chat (default: disabled)
only commonly used templates are accepted (unless --jinja is set
-hf user/repo can replace both -m and --mmproj in most cases
--image, --audio and -p are optional, if NOT provided, the CLI will run in chat mode
